o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قوم (qum), from Proto-Turkic *kum (“sand”). Cognate with Turkish kum.

Etymology tree
Arabic كَلَّفَ (kallafa)
Arabic تَكْلِيف (taklīf)bor.
Azerbaijani təklif
Borrowed from Arabic تَكْلِيف (taklīf), from كَلَّفَ (kallafa).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *ok. Cognate with Turkish ok, Turkmen ok, Gagauz ok, Salar oq, Old Turkic 𐰸 (wk¹ /⁠oq⁠/, “arrow”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish ار (er), from Proto-Turkic *ēr.
From nəfəs + -lik. A modern coinage intended to displace the Russianism фо́рточка (fórtočka) being in wide colloquial use.
From Classical Persian لیاقت (liyāqat), from Arabic لِيَاقَة (liyāqa).
